events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46268914/80d7a1c12ffa8d61e14061aa7dd769f9b6288988.jpg We’ve added two more flags to our little map. Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted Project Burnout—it means a lot that you’re interested in what we’re making. A small preview of what’s next: we’re planning to add Spanish to the demo soon as a beta translation. It’ll still be a work in progress, and we’d love your feedback when it’s ready. Thanks for being here!

events.title: Project Burnout Demo 1.0.9
events.summary: Added in-game support for bug reports, feedback, and translation issues. Stress bars now preview expected increases and recovery while you plan your week. Decision events now preview reputation gains and losses. Projects in the task tabs are now grouped by deadline, with improved visuals for dependencies and completion states, plus clearer deadline warnings. events.title: The Project Burnout demo is live!
events.summary: The Project Burnout demo is now available on Steam! You're in charge of a traveling fixer crew helping game studios in trouble. Plan the week, untangle task dependencies, and decide how much pressure your team can take before the deadline starts costing more than it solves. To mark the occasion, here's how our fictional crew handles a demo launch. Morgan may have skipped a step. Your turn to take over the schedule Try the demo and tell us how it goes.
